app.name: Supplier Carbon
app.tagline: Forward the email. Photograph the bills. Get back the completed questionnaire.

signIn.title: Sign in with your phone
signIn.lede: We will text you a code. Nothing else is stored about you.
signIn.emailLabel: Or sign in with an email link
signIn.linkSent: Check your email and open the link on this device.
signIn.error: That did not work. Check the number and try again.
signIn.devHint: Local emulator: any number works and the code is printed in the emulator log.

setup.title: About your company
setup.lede: Three things decide how your figures are calculated: where you are, which year your customer asked for, and which sites count.
setup.name: Company name
setup.startOverLede: Delete every bill, answer and result for this account. Your company details stay.
setup.startOverConfirm: Delete all bills, answers and results? Your company details will be kept.

documents.title: Your bills
documents.lede: Electricity bills, fuel invoices, LPG deliveries, refrigerant service slips. Photos or PDFs, any order, any language.
documents.needMore: Add at least one bill to continue.

reconcile.title: A few questions
reconcile.lede: We compared your bills against the reporting year. Anything missing or unclear, we ask you here.
reconcile.resetConfirm: Clear the conversation, your answers and the calculated figures? Your bills are kept, so you can answer differently.

inventory.title: Your inventory
inventory.lede: Every number traces back to a bill, a published emission factor and, where you told us something, the assumption we recorded.

questionnaire.title: Your customer's questionnaire
questionnaire.lede: Upload the Excel your customer sent. We fill every cell we can from your inventory and flag the rest.
questionnaire.share: Share of your output this customer buys (optional, for allocation)
